reviews.title: Unable to download anything on free version
reviews.text:
Sadly, the ads run forever and there’s no way to close even after watching them. 8 times out of 10 you lose all the progress. Even if you click the ad, go to app store and actually download the promoted app, you lose what you created - the ads window is still there and there’s no option to close it. 

MAKE SURE to take a screenshot of your edited picture - at least you’ll have a tiny screenshot when the download doesn’t work. 

Rarely, after the ad runs for two or more minutes, eventually a little x appears (to close the ad), and on those lucky occasions you’ll be able to save your photo. 
In most cases, the x never appears. 

A few years ago, this was not an issue - watch the ad, get the free download. Not anymore. In the last 12 months it’s been tragic.

reviews.title: Suddenly Not Working 11/17/25
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for the past 7-8 years and have never had an issue. But today, November 17, 2025, the app will open a photo and you can’t see it. The photo won’t show up at all and you can’t see what edits you’re making. I’m hoping it’s a glitch that they will fix with an update but this is really disappointing. I haven’t been able to use it at all. I’ve closed out of the app, restarted my phone, and made sure there weren’t any updates for the app (and there weren’t) but nothing fixed the issue.
